design.design_selection: Root selected logarithmic axes prospectively, before reading new application outcome times, because oldE25 showed order-of-magnitude fresh-setup costs and the main new question is compiled versus reused native
design.intended_manuscript_slot: Existing application-lifetime figure slot; manuscript remains untouched by this script
design.limits: Global minimum/maximum of all36 observations with fixed multiplicative margin; no observation exclusion
design.main_measurement: Actual parent launch to recorded actual wait for separately terminated applications only
design.native_boundary: Fresh conversion is inside each native-fresh application; once-prepared immutable CSR generation/validation is recorded separately, private mutable mapper remains per worker
design.raw_points: All three original allocation observations per arm/horizon, fixed small x offsets; shape preserves allocation pairing
design.scope: Three matched observations per configuration; retained caches and descriptive allocation variation, no population or universal-native ranking claim
design.summary: Black median segment and descriptive observed minimum/maximum whisker across exactly three allocations
design.y_axis: Shared positive logarithmic seconds scale and identical limits across both panels; no zero-based bars
